According to the repository's general rules, all JSON arrays containing paths or identifiers must be sorted lexicographically using strict byte-order comparison to prevent diff churn and maintain consistency across generated artifacts.

    "artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/full-data-governance-manual-extraction-queue.v1.json"
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure duplicate source paths, priority review paths, inventory document rows, and hash-report source rows use strict byte-order sorting (lexicographical comparison) to match the deterministic LC_ALL=C sort scan contract and prevent diff churn.
</details>
